result.rationale: The migration inserts raw site-setting values via SQL INSERT ('#{h}') without the model's before_validation normalization (host.sub! scheme/path trimming), while record_for_host compares lower(host) against URI(referer).host. Old setting values with schemes/paths (the removed site_setting_spec proves such values existed and were supported) would never match, silently breaking those embed hosts after upgrade.

judged_text: The migration inserts the raw site-setting strings (e.g. 'http://discourse.org', 'https://example.com/1234') via SQL without the model's before_validation normalization, so rows are persisted with scheme and path intact. EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares against `URI(referer).host` ('discourse.org'), so every migrated host entry that used the scheme/path formats the deleted SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? explicitly supported (the removed site_setting_spec 'works with a http host' test proves such values existed) silently stops matching after upgrade — those sites' embedded comments begin raising InvalidAccess with no error shown to the admin.

EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares against `URI(referer).host` ('discourse.org'), so every migrated host entry that used the scheme/path formats the deleted SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? explicitly supported (the removed site_setting_spec 'works with a http host' test proves such values existed) silently stops matching after upgrade — those sites' embedded comments begin raising InvalidAccess with no error shown to the admin.

adjudication.rationale: In the migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` it directly `INSERT`s `h` from the old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` value into the `embeddable_hosts.host` column via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips `http(s)://` and paths. The new allow-check (`EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`) parses the referer/embed URL with `URI(host).host` and then does `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, i.e. it compares against just the hostname like `discourse.org`. Any migrated rows stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (formats previously supported by the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?`) will not match and `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` will return false, causing `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to raise `InvalidAccess` after upgrade even though the host was previously allowed.
